cases.procedure: Use the actual due activity manual ACK control, review and Confirm.
cases.expected: Exactly one ACK; task stays TODO; closes
cases.observations: Actual owned Android notification body -> manual ACK review/Confirm; independent paired ACKNOWLEDGED, task TODO and registrations 0.
limitations: Phone interaction/accessibility remains pending.

cases.procedure: Answer, inspect unchanged durable state, type ACK and confirm its exact review.
cases.expected: Answer alone saves nothing; confirmed ACK once
cases.observations: Actual notification body -> Answer -> typed ACK review/Confirm; independent paired ACKNOWLEDGED, task TODO and registrations 0.
limitations: Typed input does not establish STT.

cases.scenario: Answer, visible hold and spoken ACK, review/Confirm
cases.procedure: Use proven synthetic virtual input during an explicit visible hold, copy/review transcript, then ACK.
cases.expected: No auto mic; reviewed ACK only
cases.observations: Actual visible recording and pinned synthetic ACK stream were observed, but recognized text did not match the expected supported reference. The guarded test refused confirmation; this does not establish voice ACK completion.
limitations: Synthetic virtual transport is not live speech. The separate direct decoder also returned a mismatching hypothesis; no unsupported grammar/model change was made.
Physical speech and device validation remain NOT_RUN.

cases.procedure: Confirm the manual snooze and inspect paired statuses, generation and future registration.
cases.expected: One future job; task stays TODO
cases.observations: Actual due state then direct private native Activity; manual snooze review/Confirm produced generation 2 PENDING/SNOOZED, task TODO and one future registration.
limitations: Private Activity entry is not notification tapping. Physical replacement delivery remains pending.

cases.procedure: Type the supported ten-minute snooze, review exact duration and confirm once.
cases.expected: One ten-minute snooze; no duplicate
cases.observations: Typed supported ten-minute snooze review/Confirm produced generation 2 PENDING/SNOOZED, task TODO and one future registration.
limitations: Typed input does not establish STT; no phone timing claim.

cases.procedure: Inject only reviewed public synthetic speech through a proven virtual mic; review the snooze.
cases.expected: Same atomic result as manual snooze
cases.observations: Visible recording and the pinned synthetic snooze stream were observed, but the captured result did not satisfy the exact supported-reference guard (NO_AUDIO_SIGNAL in this attempt). No snooze confirmation was executed.
limitations: The separate direct decoder returned a nonmatching snooze hypothesis, so the emulator outcome is not attributed solely to transport.
No real microphone/acoustics or physical acceptance is established.

cases.procedure: Background without force-stop, wait due, inspect and open the actual OS notification.
cases.expected: Notification/eligible reminder UI; controls work
cases.observations: App was backgrounded with HOME before due; independent due RINGING then actual notification body -> typed ACK confirmed; task TODO and registrations 0.
limitations: One API 37 preview x86_64 AVD; physical OEM background delivery remains pending.

cases.procedure: Lock the existing emulator, wait due and inspect OS-permitted presentation.
cases.expected: OS-permitted notification/call-style presentation
cases.observations: The bounded attempt could not establish its supported unsecured-keyguard precondition. No mutation occurred; showing=false without a supported secure-state field was not treated as proof of the required condition.
limitations: Locked-background delivery has not been executed in this expansion.
No physical secured-lock or OEM behavior is established.

cases.procedure: Turn emulator screen off before due and record actual wake/presentation and drift.
cases.expected: Wake/presentation only within OS limits; record drift
cases.observations: Retry established noninteractive Asleep with HAL interactive mode false before due. Independent paired RINGING was observed, then actual notification body -> typed ACK review/Confirm produced paired ACKNOWLEDGED, task TODO and registrations 0. Initial condition-establishment failure remains preserved.
limitations: This certifies the observed virtual noninteractive condition, not physical hardware screen-off/wake or OEM delivery.

cases.procedure: Confirm forced Doze state, wait due, record any throttling, then unforce and observe recovery.
cases.expected: Record delivery/drift and capability limits
cases.observations: Forced deep IDLE was confirmed before due. Independent SQL observed paired RINGING/task TODO while forced idle remained active. Explicit unforce/wake/Main recovery and actual notification ACK review/Confirm then produced paired ACKNOWLEDGED, task TODO and registrations 0. Selected power/battery/global settings were restored.
limitations: Forced virtual deep IDLE is not natural or physical OEM Doze.
Timing, natural-idle delivery, physical energy and phone battery behavior are not certified.

cases.procedure: Establish battery saver on this image, wait due and inspect honest delivery constraints.
cases.expected: Honest constraints; no false delivered/ACK claim
cases.observations: Initial attempt could not confirm saver activity with its legacy dump-field parser and was recorded NOT_RUN with restoration PASS. A fresh-fixture retry confirmed the API37 Battery saving stats ON row and low_power 1, observed paired RINGING under the confirmed saver, then actual notification ACK produced paired ACKNOWLEDGED, task TODO and registrations 0. Saver OFF, baseline power/battery and selected global settings were restored.
limitations: The initial unsupported condition parser is preserved as NOT_RUN, not relabeled a product delivery failure.
Simulated battery saver is not energy measurement, natural phone power policy or a punctuality guarantee.

cases.scenario: OS removes background process before due
cases.procedure: Background then kill only safe-to-kill capstone processes; verify PID loss and due recovery.
cases.expected: Durable record recovers within OS limits
cases.observations: After backgrounding, safe am kill removed the previously observed app PIDs. At due, paired RINGING recovered; actual notification body -> typed ACK review/Confirm produced paired ACKNOWLEDGED, task TODO and registrations 0.
limitations: am kill is not force-stop or genuine phone low-memory eviction; no physical process-pressure acceptance is established.

cases.scenario: Swipe app from recents before due
cases.procedure: Remove the app task from recents and wait for the alarm.
cases.expected: Record OEM behavior; no invented delivery guarantee
cases.observations: Removed only the app-owned MainActivity task via appTasks finishAndRemoveTask after verifying base/top activity. Independent pending SCHEDULED/TODO generation1 and one registration remained unchanged. The reminder actually became due, current System UI notification typed review/Confirm ACK produced paired ACKNOWLEDGED, task TODO and zero registrations; the owned fixture was then soft removed through reviewed UI.
limitations: Actual System UI Recents swipe gesture and physical/OEM recents behavior were NOT_RUN.
An app-task API removal is not a force-stop or physical low-memory kill.

cases.scenario: Force-stop before due, then reopen after due
cases.procedure: Force-stop before due, observe the restriction, then explicitly reopen and inspect reconciliation.
cases.expected: No promise while force-stopped; reopen reconciles
cases.observations: Force-stopped state was verified and notification/delivery remained suppressed beyond due, with paired PENDING/SCHEDULED. Explicit Main reopening recovered paired RINGING; actual notification ACK confirmation produced paired ACKNOWLEDGED, task TODO and registrations 0.
limitations: No delivery is promised while Android keeps the package force-stopped. This is one preview-API AVD recovery observation.

cases.scenario: Reboot before due; unlock phone as required
cases.procedure: Reboot the existing AVD without wiping, unlock as required and inspect one restored alarm.
cases.expected: Restore/reconcile once; record locked-boot limits
cases.observations: A real guest reboot was confirmed by changed boot identity and boot-completed state. Due was 13:37:01.460Z; paired RINGING was independently observed at 13:38:16.858Z, followed by actual notification ACK confirmation with task TODO and registrations 0. This establishes eventual recovery, not punctual delivery.
limitations: Recovery was delayed: the recorded response deadline is consistent with a ringing window beginning around 13:38:12.567Z (~71 seconds after due); the independent RINGING observation was ~75 seconds after due.
No physical secured-unlock, OEM reboot timing or prompt-delivery guarantee is established.

cases.scenario: Restart app with an outstanding alarm
cases.procedure: Restart with an outstanding alarm and inspect its original durable identity and registrations.
cases.expected: Existing reminder/job survives without duplicates
cases.observations: App was backgrounded and safe am kill removed the old PIDs. Explicit Main relaunch retained paired PENDING/SCHEDULED, original UTC due time/generation and exactly one local registration; actual due then notification ACK review/Confirm produced paired ACKNOWLEDGED, task TODO and registrations 0.
limitations: Controlled am kill/relaunch does not certify physical low-memory eviction or every OEM restart policy.

cases.scenario: Change wall clock forward across due
cases.procedure: Capture automatic time, change only emulator wall time forward across due and inspect late policy.
cases.expected: Reconcile consistent state; record late policy
cases.observations: Actual guest wall clock advanced 120 seconds across the owned pending reminder due time. Real TIME_SET reconciliation produced paired RINGING; actual notification body -> typed ACK review/Confirm then produced paired ACKNOWLEDGED, task TODO and registrations 0. Original host clock offset was restored to second resolution with four-second tolerance, automatic time 1 and GMT; exact owned fixture was cleaned via reviewed UI.
limitations: One bounded virtual clock jump and reconciliation path, not physical OS/OEM timing or arbitrary clock changes.

cases.scenario: Change wall clock backward before due
cases.procedure: Move only emulator wall time backward; verify review expiry and no duplicated/cross-target action.
cases.expected: No duplicate/stale ACK; record actual timing
cases.observations: Narrower case: after actual due and visible ACK review, guest clock moved backward 120 seconds. Real TIME_SET reconciliation retired the original paired RINGING reminder/job to MISSED. Attempting cached old Confirm did not ACK: independent paired MISSED, task TODO and registrations 0 remained. Original host clock offset was restored to second resolution with four-second tolerance, automatic time 1 and GMT; exact owned fixture was cleaned via reviewed UI.
limitations: Original manual scenario of moving the clock backward BEFORE due remains NOT_RUN. This PASS covers a real backward jump DURING a ringing response review only.
One preview-API AVD; physical clock-change/OEM acceptance remains pending.

cases.procedure: Change emulator timezone and inspect UTC storage plus displayed schedule semantics.
cases.expected: Stored instant/defined timezone semantics preserved
cases.observations: Actual guest timezone changed GMT -> Asia/Manila (+8 hours) before due. Independent SQL preserved the original UTC runAt, generation and single registration. Actual due then notification ACK review/Confirm produced paired ACKNOWLEDGED, task TODO and registrations 0. GMT and automatic-timezone 1 were restored to baseline.
limitations: One fixed task instant across a real guest timezone change; weekly recurring/DST behavior and physical OEM acceptance are not established.

The exact fixture was cleaned through reviewed Chat while denial remained in effect, then permission/grant flags and settings were restored.
